about.howBody: Students pick their course from their university catalogue, or submit a tutoring request describing what they need. Approved teachers then offer prices and timelines, and the student picks the best fit. Payment is by bank transfer to the academy account only; the receipt is uploaded to the dashboard and approved by our team before any service opens.
about.integrityBody: We never display inflated numbers, and reviews come only from students who actually completed their subscriptions — the admin does not enter ratings manually.
about.intro: Siraj Educational Academy is a Saudi platform connecting university students with teachers whose credentials have been verified. Our philosophy is simple: focused explanations, prices shown up front, and secure bank-transfer payment through the academy account with human approval for every transaction.
about.v1.d: Price and timeline are shown before you choose — no surprises after payment.
about.v2.d: Every teacher and course passes admin review before publishing.
about.v3.d: A team supporting students and teachers over WhatsApp and Telegram throughout the week.

faq.1.a: Choose your university and then the course from the courses page, pick the offering that suits you, subscribe and upload your transfer receipt. Once approved, the content opens in your account.
faq.1.q: How do I get my course?
faq.2.a: Submit the request from the private tutoring page. After review it is published, teachers submit offers with prices and timelines, you choose the best one from your dashboard, and a payment request opens for that amount.
faq.2.q: How does a private tutoring request work?
faq.3.a: Payment is made only by bank transfer to the academy account (details appear in your orders dashboard). You upload the receipt and it is reviewed manually before the service opens.
faq.4.a: Every teacher passes an admin review of qualification, specialisation, and verification documents before their content or offers appear.
faq.5.a: If delivery does not start within the agreed time, contact support to cancel the order and get a refund under our refund policy.
faq.5.q: What if the service is not delivered?
faq.6.a: Yes — some courses are free, and many paid courses include trial lessons you can watch before subscribing.
faq.7.a: Create a teacher account from the sign-up page. Once approved, you can publish courses, apply to tutoring requests, schedule live sessions, and post approved ads.
faq.7.q: How can I promote myself as a teacher?
faq.8.a: Via WhatsApp or Telegram — links are at the bottom of every page.
faq.8.q: How do I reach customer support?
faq.title: Frequently asked
